title: Unique violation on an organization-scoped index names no field: the server drops the field when the composite key is (organization_id, column), so the form can only say "A record with this value already exists"
body:
domain:ui#6 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUAXJEaRNwDiLuAvEZ

carries item 2 of #32684; #32684 keeps item 1 (the file-type refusal read as a permission error, and the file widget's missing `accept` hint). Item 3 (the upload-link page) is carried by a separate card.

Filing category: ① product defect (user-visible). reach: as measured on #32684 (console record form, zh-CN, hosted tenant; `pnpm dev:stack --with-ui`; cloud `ff373e02`, framework `d7c3d44e`).

## 维护者速读

员工录入报销明细时，如果发票号码重复，表单顶部只显示一句英文「A record with this value already exists」，不说是哪个字段。原因在服务端：发票号码的唯一约束按组织划分（`unique: 'organization'`），数据库里是「组织 + 发票号码」两列的组合索引，服务端遇到组合键时故意不报字段名，所以前端拿不到字段，也就无法显示「发票号码已存在」。

## What happens (from #32684 item 2)

A unique index on `invoice_no` declared `unique: 'organization'`; a duplicate number answers `409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION` with no `field`, and the form shows the server sentence 「A record with this value already exists」 at the top of the zh-CN form, naming no field. Server log: `UNIQUE constraint failed: k7en_claim_line.organization_id, k7en_claim_line.invoice_no`.

## Where it comes from (read on `6bbdf301`, by the `domain:ui#6` seat's read-only premise check)

- The sentence is a server string: `packages/types/src/data-error-classification.ts` (~:1110 the `DuplicateRecordError` branch, ~:1749 the raw driver unique-violation branch). Both send `409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION` with `field` only when ONE column can be determined; the `DuplicateRecordError` branch also sends `fieldLabel` and then says "A record with this ${label} already exists".
- A composite key deliberately resolves to no `field`: `packages/types/src/unique-violation.ts` (~:302, ~:390) and `packages/objectql/src/duplicate-record-error.ts` (~:60-66, "a wrong field name is worse than none").
- `unique: 'organization'` builds exactly such a composite (scope column + the field), so the declared single-field uniqueness never reaches the client as a field.
- The console already reads a `409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION` that names its `field` (`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` ~:2004), so once the server names the field the ui side is small (a localized per-field message).

## Expected

When the violated index is a field declared `unique: '<scope>'` (the scope column(s) plus one field), the refusal names that field (`field`, `fieldLabel`), so the form can show 「发票号码已存在」 on the field. A genuinely multi-field user index keeps naming none.

Reader who acts: `domain:server` (unique-violation classification in `packages/types` / `packages/objectql`); a localized ui rendering may follow as a `domain:ui` card once the field arrives. Triage decides the lane and grade.

Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue UNIQUE_VIOLATION composite field` and `unique organization scope field name refusal` → 24 and 108 hits; the closest are #24951 (closed: the unique refusal sentence names the object) and #29176 (closed: empty string on an optional unique field). None is about a scope-composite key dropping the field.

Related: #32684.
